historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta describes Semal as a kingdom and major trading center located in the western Sudan, present-day Mauritania. He visited the area in the late 14th century (1352 AD).

The Mali Empire, which included Semal, reached its height in the 14th century under Mansa Musa's rule (1312-1337 AD). The empire was known for its wealth and international trade, including the trans-Saharan trade route.
